sourceTask.excerpt:
# CORE-DELIVERY-001 — complete the actual local core journey

User authorization: 2026-10-01, “complete the core works fully ..create goal for it
and proceed and verify the full working by doing actual testing as if it is deployed
and tested in realtime”, with core priority and no trivial edge-case campaigns.
The coordinator created an active Codex goal. Sol/high plans and independently
reviews; Luna/xhigh is the sole implementation writer. Root owns shared Brain.

Adopt .brain/evidence/core-delivery-001-plan-01.md. The executable core already
exists. Demonstrate one newly composed all-local product through the actual paired
full console and immutable managed application: New composition/edit/preview/save/
exact load/build/register/inspect/promote/start; actual scoped Desk record, indexed
Knowledge and exact cited local extractive answer, Handoff destination receipt;
tenant isolation; positive stop/same-instance restart with retained owner data;
private backup/verify/absent-owned-root restore/explicit restart; final positive
stop and original-owner fixture closure. Use real compile/export/native supervision,
HTTP and domain stores. Source sample records, mock adapters and pre-promoted setup
do not qualify the continuous journey.

Reconcile atlas planning focus and relevant source pins with this canonical task
before implementation. Preserve plan5 and every earlier observation. BRAIN-005
separately repairs actual managed readiness; its acceptance does not accept the
platform. No arbitrary execution or automatic source integration is introduced.

Initial maintained write scope is README.md to clarify the full-console entry.
tests/build-worker-process.test.mjs is eligible only after a concrete diagnosis
of its already observed startup-heartbeat failure. Preserve native descendant,
EMPTY/helper-close/CLEAN assertions and application timeouts. Any demonstrated
core application defect needs a named owner and explicit bounded contract revision
before repair. The contract's full maintained inventory fingerprints the reviewed
runtime, tooling and tests; it is not blanket edit permission.

Luna may create operational .local/core-delivery-001 fixture/probe files. Start with
a fresh short private checkout, reviewed source/toolchain/host and source catalogue,
no synthetic build rows or prebuilt/promotion shortcuts. Exact fixture-identity
controls request original-owner closure. Credentials/pairing codes stay private.
An absent-root recovery simulation can remove only the positively stopped exact
test-owned data target after checked containment and verified backup. Never reseed
existing stores or manufacture lifecycle proof.

Build before tests, record actual focused checks, freeze source before the continuous
journey and final required npm test, obtain independent exact review and archive
sanitized screenshots/DOM/identities/exit logs. Preserve actual failed, blocked and
unrun evidence separately. Existing file-upload permission denial remains BLOCKED;
ordinary New composition/edit is a distinct journey and does not qualify denied
file import. PLATFORM-007's earlier blocked acceptance is retained at checkpoint27.

Completion means verified deployed local core at the stated scope, with all required
journey steps observed. Hosted identity/database, model inference, external
deployment/credentials/spending/global settings, controller-crash/stress campaigns,
signing/install/uninstall and portfolio automation remain outside this increment.
The original full program stays open beyond this core milestone.

Actual attempt01 disposition: .brain/evidence/core-delivery-001-browser-01.json.
Fresh source-only console, real starter and exact custom-binding preview passed;
first Products catalogue rendering failed through a confirmed redundant hash race.
Native Save confirmation was observed but CUA acceptance failed in transport;
read-only DB proves no custom save/build. Original owned fixture closed with actual
outer exit0. These are preserved failures, not product/browser acceptance.

Current finite maintained writer scope supersedes the initial
